title: Q-GAP-multi-tenant-controls: Controls required before any multi-tenant hosted offering
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** every executor run
**Done check:** file:docs/security/multi-tenant-controls.json
**Status:** open

Multi-tenant hosting is a different obligation from a bring-your-own-account pilot. List and prove the controls in doctrine/pilot-model.json `multi_tenant_obligations` (isolation test, encryption, processor terms, breach path, per-tenant budget) in docs/security/multi-tenant-controls.json before the hosted tier is offered.
